usedFor: Teamgate holds sales leads and CallHippo handles calls and texts, so “New Lead Created” in Teamgate can run “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Teamgate, then “Send SMS” in CallHippo
bestTemplate.why: A new lead gets a text sent through your CallHippo account.

watchOut: “New Lead Created” in Teamgate is polling, so the text goes out after a scheduled check.
